title: elsholtzia cyprianii
intro: Elsholtzia cyprianii, commonly known as Vietnamese coriander, is a type of plant in the Lamiaceae family, native to Vietnam and China. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Elsholtzia cyprianii include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve coughs, and promote digestive health, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. These bioactive compounds are responsible for its therapeutic effects, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
